purpose: Five generated concept alternatives for user selection, not in-game renders

sources.title: Dane Hallett — Furiosa / Black Avenger alternate versions
Crossout — frontal machine gun developer blog

prompts.name: Открытый пулемёт
prompts.brief: Design 01: A compact exposed old-fashioned belt-fed machine gun sitting on the DRIVER-SIDE HALF of the hood beside the supercharger. A flat rectangular receiver with recognisable top cover, one slender barrel with a SHORT perforated cooling sleeve, a small box magazine/ammo tin and a few visible feed links. Low OPEN TRIANGULAR welded cradle with two narrow side braces bolted to a flat plate; no turret enclosure at all. The barrel and brackets should be elegant and lean, visually borrowing the Black Avenger's open construction at a MUCH SMALLER game-friendly scale. Keep the single muzzle visibly separate from the supercharger. Large text: "01".
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished vehicle design concept sheet for a casual mobile idle arcade RPG. This is a NEW concept artwork, not a screenshot edit.
Input image roles:
Image 1 is the current game's graphite muscle car, shown in a before/after montage. Use ONLY the car in the LOWER ROW as the vehicle identity reference. Preserve its recognisable classic Mustang-like fastback shape, graphite paint, two warm ivory racing stripes, chrome bumper, four round front headlights, broad tyres, and small hood supercharger. Ignore all captions, UI, and old gun designs.
Image 2 is the friendly mechanic Quasimodo character reference: preserve his small friendly figure, yellow-brown work clothes, cap, blue goggles and rear-deck harpoon role.
Image 3 is Dane Hallett's Black Avenger alternate concept, used ONLY as inspiration for exposed practical weapon mount language, visible mechanical gun receiver, dark worn metal and compact welded brackets. Do NOT copy its car body, its huge weapon scale, spiked bumper, roof intake or monochrome rendering.
Style: polished CLEAN STYLIZED 3D GAME CONCEPT, rounded bevels, readable forms, broad soft highlights, warm desert sand studio ground and quiet background, slightly weathered gunmetal and a little rusty fastener detail. Match our casual game car; NOT photorealistic, NOT a flat vector illustration.
Composition: landscape 3:2 design sheet. A large complete car shown from a clear elevated FRONT THREE-QUARTER angle, its nose towards the lower-left, with the hood and the entire proposed weapon clearly visible. At the right add a smaller true TOP-DOWN view of THE SAME CAR WITH THE EXACT SAME WEAPON and a close-up of the hood gun underneath. All views must agree. Keep the top-down view readable, not tiny.
Vehicle invariants: retain current car body, paint, stripes, wheels and friendly rear mechanic. Rear harpoon remains stowed toward the rear and must not look like another hood gun. Leave the roof clear.
Primary design task: replace the current tiny round tank-like dome and pipe with a convincing, visibly recognisable compact vehicle firearm. ONE firing barrel and ONE receiver on the HOOD, never a roof turret. The car is the main mass; weapon is an accessory. Gun and mounting together occupy at most roughly one quarter of the hood area; one slim barrel approximately a third of hood length. Gun sits LOW, with a compact receiver, plausible simple brackets, very clear muzzle. Avoid spherical cupolas, toy laser tubes, giant autocannons, miniguns, multiple barrels, tall pedestal, oversized shields, giant spikes, missiles, muzzle fire and game HUD. Show the weapon at rest, aimed forward. A small ammo container or a short visible feed belt may help the weapon read naturally, but keep both restrained.
Text: only the large variant number specified below, top-left. No other words, logos, watermark or long annotations.

prompts.name: Утопленный ствол
prompts.brief: Design 02: A compact firearm BUILT INTO a narrow recessed channel in the PASSENGER-SIDE HALF of the hood alongside the blower. The small rectangular receiver is partially inset, with a little exposed top cover and a short feed detail visible in a neat opening. One clearly mechanical slim barrel points forward just above the hood surface. Small rounded rectangular reinforcing rim around the channel. It should feel purpose-built into the car, the LOWEST and cleanest silhouette of the five, yet unmistakably a physical gun with visible receiver and muzzle. No round dome and no large external mounting stand. Large text: "02".

prompts.name: На краю капота
prompts.brief: Design 03: A compact classic air-cooled machine gun mounted ALONG THE OUTER DRIVER-SIDE EDGE of the hood, just inside the fender line, above and behind the headlamp. One slender barrel inside a visibly PERFORATED CYLINDRICAL cooling jacket, a narrow rectangular receiver, small side-mounted ammo box. Two low rugged strap brackets fasten it to the fender/hood edge; asymmetrical garage-built Mad Max vehicle personality. Keep it light and low and fully supported, no giant cantilever. The central hood and supercharger remain very visible. This option's distinguishing silhouette is the long narrow cooling sleeve running along the hood edge, NOT the open triangular frame of option 01. Large text: "03".

prompts.name: Под бронекожухом
prompts.brief: Design 04: A small hood-mounted machine gun partly protected by a LOW ANGULAR ARMOURED HALF-SHROUD. Put this on the driver-side half of the hood next to the blower. The shroud is a narrow horizontal wedge made of three dark steel plates, clipped corners, restrained rivets and a few broad cooling slots; OPEN at the rear so the actual rectangular receiver and feed can still be read. ONE slim clearly exposed barrel emerges well forward from the cover. The silhouette is wider and tougher than option 02 but still small, below the windshield's lower quarter, no round turret and no pedestal. Must look like an improvised armoured gun enclosure on a muscle car, not a tank turret or a roof box. Large text: "04".

prompts.name: На носу капота
prompts.brief: Design 05: A compact SINGLE-BARREL STUBBY AUTOCANNON mounted at the FRONT CENTER of the hood, immediately above the grille and IN FRONT OF the small supercharger. If necessary move the blower a little backwards along the hood to give them separate clear silhouettes. Gun is a SHORT LOW RECTANGULAR RECEIVER in a simple shallow U-shaped metal cradle. One short barrel with a small slotted muzzle brake reaches only slightly past the front hood lip. This option feels like a tough little forward-firing 'nose gun' built into a pursuit car; the short cannon reads solid and mechanical but must remain much smaller than a tank weapon. No circular cupola, no tall post, no huge armour, no barrel cluster. Large text: "05".
